scorecard.description: Scorecard indicates this alert type also feeds Driver Scorecard scoring.

token.description: Token is populated ONLY in the create response (shown once).

value.description: km/h over limit, or km/h/s for harsh

metadata.description:
Metadata is the raw per-device sensor blob (fuel, voltages, GSM/GNSS, etc.).
Only populated on the single-vehicle detail path; the bulk list trims it.

idle_min.description: IdleMin is how long the vehicle sat at this point's stop (0 while moving).

over_limit.description: OverLimit is true when Speed exceeds the requested limit at this point.

battery_v.description:
From the telemetry collector's state table (updated ~2min) — cheap to
join fleet-wide, powers list filters without shipping metadata blobs.

km_since_service.description:
Maintenance context: km driven since the last recorded service. Nil when
unknown; HasServiceRecord=false means no maintenance record exists yet.

last_done_at.description:
When the last service happened and the odometer reading at that time —
this is what "km since last service" everywhere is computed from.

last_service_km.description:
Maintenance context for the odometer: km driven since the most recent
recorded service. Nil when the vehicle has no service records yet.

duration_hours.description: takes precedence over days when set

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
